metadata.question: Does Asir, Saudi Arabia show higher NDVI in June 2016 and  2017, compared with the long-term average for that period from 2003–2011?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Asir region, Saudi Arabia (need to define geometry - roughly 17-20°N, 42-45°E) - Collection: Landsat 8 (covers both periods and has NDVI calculability) - Dates: June 2016, June 2017 (comparison years) vs June 2003-2011 (baseline) - Need to compare mean NDVI for each year/period 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking (QA band) to ensure valid vegetation data - NDVI is sensitive to clouds/shadows, so filtering is essential 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If no images exist for a date range → C1 - If valid pixels after masking = 0 → C2 - If NDVI calculation results in None/NaN or out of valid range [-1, 1] → C3 - Valid answer: Compare mean NDVI(2016+2017)/2 > mean NDVI(2003-2011) → A or B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Asir, Saudi Arabia geometry (approximate bounding box) const asir = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([42.0, 17.0, 45.0, 20.0]); // Function to mask clouds using QA band function maskClouds(img) { const qa = img.select('BQA'); const mask = qa.lt(2720); // Keep only clear/water pixels return img.updateMask(mask).select(['B4', 'B5']); // Red, NIR } // Function to calculate NDVI function calcNDVI(img) { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']); return ndvi.rename('NDVI'); } // Baseline period: June 2003-2011 const baseline = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LM05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(asir) .filterDate('2003-06-01', '2011-06-30') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 6, 'month')) .map(maskClouds) .map(calcNDVI); const baselineSize = baseline.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline (2003-2011) Images: ${baselineSize}`); if (baselineSize === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8 for baseline...'); const baseline8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(asir) .filterDate('2003-06-01', '2011-06-30') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 6, 'month')) .map(maskClouds) .map(calcNDVI); const bs8 = baseline8.size().getInfo(); if (bs8 === 0) { console.log('No baseline data available.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Comparison period: June 2016 & 2017 const comp2016 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(asir) .filterDate('2016-06-01', '2016-06-30') .map(maskClouds) .map(calcNDVI); const comp2017 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(asir) .filterDate('2017-06-01', '2017-06-30') .map(maskClouds) .map(calcNDVI); const c2016Size = comp2016.size().getInfo(); const c2017Size = comp2017.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2016 Images: ${c2016Size}, 2017 Images: ${c2017Size}`); if (c2016Size === 0 || c2017Size === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI for each period const baselineMean = baseline.mean(); const comp2016Mean = comp2016.mean(); const comp2017Mean = comp2017.mean(); // Get pixel counts to detect C2 const baselineCount = baselineMean .reduceRegion(reducer = ee.Reducer.count(), geometry = asir, scale = 1000, maxPixels = 1e9) .get('NDVI').getInfo(); const comp2016Count = comp2016Mean .reduceRegion(reducer = ee.Reducer.count(), geometry = asir, scale = 1000, maxPixels = 1e9) .get('NDVI').getInfo(); if (baselineCount === 0 || comp2016Count === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean values const baselineVal = baselineMean .reduceRegion(reducer = ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry = asir, scale = 1000, maxPixels = 1e9) .get('NDVI').getInfo(); const comp2016Val = comp2016Mean .reduceRegion(reducer = ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry = asir, scale = 1000, maxPixels = 1e9) .get('NDVI').getInfo(); const comp2017Val = comp2017Mean .reduceRegion(reducer = ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry = asir, scale = 1000, maxPixels = 1e9) .get('NDVI').getInfo(); if (baselineVal === null || comp2016Val === null || comp2017Val === null || isNaN(baselineVal) || isNaN(comp2016Val) || isNaN(comp2017Val)) { console.log('Calculation failed (NaN or null).'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Validation: check NDVI range if (baselineVal < -1 || baselineVal > 1 || comp2016Val < -1 || comp2016Val > 1 || comp2017Val < -1 || comp2017Val > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI range detected.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const compAvg = (comp2016Val + comp2017Val) / 2; console.log(`Baseline (2003-2011) NDVI: ${baselineVal.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${Math.round(baselineCount)}`); console.log(`2016 NDVI: ${comp2016Val.toFixed(4)}, 2017 NDVI: ${comp2017Val.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Comparison Avg (2016+2017): ${compAvg.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Difference: ${(compAvg - baselineVal).toFixed(4)}`); if (compAvg > baselineVal) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
